# routeros_ipv6_nd_prefix_default (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ipv6_nd_prefix_default" "default" {
  autonomous         = true
  dhcp6_pd_preferred = true
  preferred_lifetime = "10s"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `autonomous` (Boolean) When set, indicates that this prefix can be used for autonomous address configuration. Otherwise, the prefix information is silently ignored. *Default: `yes`*
- `dhcp6_pd_preferred` (Boolean) Advertise the prefixes obtained by the DHCPv6-PD client with this default template. *Default: `no`*
- `preferred_lifetime` (String) Timeframe (relative to the time the packet is sent) after which the generated address becomes `deprecated`. A deprecated address is used only for already existing connections and is usable until the valid lifetime expires. *Default: `1w`*
- `valid_lifetime` (String) The length of time (relative to the time the packet is sent) an address remains in the valid state. The valid lifetime must be greater than or equal to the preferred lifetime. *Default: `4w2d`*

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ipv6/nd/prefix/default get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ipv6_nd_prefix_default.default "*1"
```
